sources.title: Mungert/Trinity-Mini-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Trinity Mini Trinity Mini is an Arcee AI 26B MoE model with 3B active parameters. It is the medium-sized model in our new Trinity family, a series of open-weight models for enterprise and tinkerers alike. This model is tuned for reasoning, but in testing, it uses a similar total token count to competitive instruction-tuned models.

sources.snippet: The Intern-S1-mini model in GGUF format can be utilized by llama.cpp, a highly popular open-source framework for Large Language Model (LLM) inference, across a variety of hardware platforms, both locally and in the cloud.
